lead.event: IDX removes five stocks from the November 2026 short-selling list
lead.headline: IDX removes five stocks from November short-selling list, leaving none eligible
lead.blurb: The Indonesia Stock Exchange removed Astra International, Bank Central Asia, Barito Pacific, Bumi Resources and Indofood Sukses Makmur from the November list, leaving no stocks eligible for short selling. The exchange had only begun implementing short selling on 1 October. The removal followed the IHSG's 11.67% plunge on 16 October after MSCI proposed reclassifying Indonesia from emerging to standalone market. MSCI's decision is due by 30 June 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesian authorities implement capital-market reforms after MSCI turmoil
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia launches eight capital-market reforms after MSCI turmoil
market_structure_policy.blurb: OJK and BEI are raising the minimum free float from 7.5% to 15% as part of the package. BEI plans to exclude 80 high-concentration stocks, representing about 18% of IHSG weight, from the IHSG, IDX30, LQ45 and IDX80 from 2 November.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions in the DSSA-related market-manipulation case draw disclosures and a fine-payment update
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK confirms receipt of Rp2.1 trillion in fines tied to DSSA, BREN and CUAN
market_structure_policy.blurb: Pandu Sjahrir disclosed a passive, indirect 27.5% stake in Supra Sekuritas, one of nine exchange members sanctioned in the DSSA case. On 16 October, OJK imposed Rp1.5 trillion on SMT for DSSA, Rp500 billion on AH Ltd for BREN and Rp100 billion on TC Pte Ltd for CUAN.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

other.headline: PGAS signs seven gas and LNG agreements with reported US$10.61 billion value
other.blurb: PGN's Abadi Masela LNG agreement is valued at about US$7.35 billion and covers planned deliveries over 15 years. Inpex Masela Ltd, Pertamina Hulu Energi Masela and Searah Masela San Bhd are the sellers, with supply expected to start in 2033.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri analyst target price is raised after guidance changes
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises BMRI target price, sees up to 69% upside
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri raised its 2026 loan-growth target to 9–11% from 7–9% and cut its cost-to-income target to 37–39% from 39–41%. BRI Danareksa analysts Victor Stefano and Nataniella Eva Kezia raised 2026–2027 net profit estimates by 2–4%, citing stronger loan growth prospects, improved credit pricing and a healthier credit mix.

earnings_guidance.headline: BRMS returns to profit with US$11.01 million in Q3
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue rose 172.8% quarter on quarter to US$71.79 million. Gold sales climbed to 16,748 ounces from 6,301 ounces after the Poboya open-pit pushback was completed in July.

earnings_guidance.event: GoTo reports nine-month 2026 profit and raises its full-year EBITDA target
earnings_guidance.headline: GOTO reports nine-month profit and lifts 2026 adjusted EBITDA target to Rp3.5-3.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: GoTo posted net profit attributable to parent owners of Rp1.16 trillion for January-September, reversing a Rp775.55 billion loss a year earlier. It recorded its third consecutive quarterly profit, including Rp441 billion in Q3 versus a Rp255 billion loss a year earlier.

earnings_guidance.headline: COIN reports Rp40.78 billion nine-month net loss
earnings_guidance.blurb: The loss compares with Rp25.51 billion profit a year earlier, while basic loss per share was Rp2.77 versus earnings of Rp2.04. Indokripto’s revenue fell 34.78% to Rp73.78 billion, while general and administrative expenses rose to Rp121.47 billion.

deals_control.event: Dian Swastatika Sentosa buys BSD City land for data-center expansion
deals_control.headline: DSSA agrees to buy BSD City land for Rp3.1 trillion data-center expansion
deals_control.blurb: Dian Swastatika Sentosa agreed through an indirect subsidiary to buy 166,261 square meters from Surya Inter Wisesa, in an affiliated transaction between companies under Sinar Mas Group. The land in BSD City’s D-Hub Special Economic Zone is intended to support data-center development, with the agreement signed on 26 October.

deals_control.event: Bank Mandiri sells its Inhealth stake to IFG Life for Rp570 billion
deals_control.headline: BMRI plans to sell its 20% Inhealth stake to IFG Life for Rp570 billion
deals_control.blurb: The conditional agreement, signed 26 October, also covers Inhealth’s 45.14% stake in Fitaja Digital Nusantara. Completion remains subject to required approvals, after which IFG Life would own all of Inhealth.

deals_control.event: BIKE acquires a 72% stake in coal miner Berau Usaha Mandiri
deals_control.headline: BIKE acquires 72% of Berau Usaha Mandiri
deals_control.blurb: Berau Usaha Mandiri holds about 22 million metric tons of proven reserves across a roughly 500-hectare concession in East Kalimantan. Bhineka management targets annual production of 1.5 million to 2.5 million metric tons.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Chandra Asri halts and replaces its share-buyback program
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TPIA ends Rp1 trillion buyback and starts a new one of up to Rp2 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Chandra Asri ended its previous program on 28 October and began the replacement on 29 October. The new buyback covers up to 1.6 billion shares, or 1.84% of issued shares, at no more than Rp3,000 per share through 28 January 2027, with BCA Sekuritas executing purchases using internal cash.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The prior buyback ended on 28 October and the replacement program began on 29 October 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Gold Resources secures a US$435 million loan facility
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS secures loan facility of up to US$435 million
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The facility is classified as material because it exceeds 50% of Merdeka Gold Resources’ equity, but requires no shareholder approval. It comprises a US$150 million term loan and a revolving credit facility of up to US$285 million from CIMB Niaga, Bank Danamon, DBS, Kasikornbank and Maybank Indonesia. It matures on 26 October 2031.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The facility is classified as material because it exceeds 50% of EMAS’s equity.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: NexAI Digital schedules Rp2.53 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MGLV schedules Rp2.53 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: NexAI Digital will issue 285.73 million shares at Rp8,880 each, at 15 rights for every 100 shares. Majority shareholder Nextier Datamate Center, which holds 62.71%, says it will exercise all its entitlements, worth about Rp1.59 trillion. Cum rights trading in regular and negotiation markets starts 4 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BNI conducts a Rp547 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBNI announces share buyback of up to Rp547 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BNI shares had fallen more than 20% since the start of 2026. The bank will fund the buyback entirely from internal cash during the period ending 27 January 2027. Repurchased shares will later be transferred as treasury shares under OJK regulations.
